In the new `addGuestsHandler` (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts), the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` includes organizer/attendees/etc. but never sets a `team` field, and the booking query only includes `eventType: true` (no team/members).
